doc: Every ocgcore message that waits for a player's answer (source: third_party/ocgcore/playerop.cpp). layout: fields after the message id byte; types u8/u16/u32/u64/i32; 'loc' = con:u8,loc:u8,seq:u32,pos:u32; list<count type>[fields] repeats. response: what OCG_DuelSetResponse receives. Each row generates a record + decoder (gen_code.py).

rows.name: MSG_SELECT_BATTLECMD
rows.response: i32 (index<<16)|action; action 0=activate chains[index], 1=attack with attackers[index], 2=Main Phase 2, 3=End Phase

rows.name: MSG_SELECT_IDLECMD
rows.response: i32 (index<<16)|action; 0 summon,1 special summon,2 change position,3 set monster,4 set spell/trap,5 activate,6 Battle Phase,7 End Phase,8 shuffle hand

rows.name: MSG_SELECT_EFFECTYN
rows.response: i32 1 yes / 0 no

rows.name: MSG_SELECT_YESNO
rows.response: i32 1 yes / 0 no

rows.name: MSG_SELECT_OPTION
rows.response: i32 option index

rows.name: MSG_SELECT_CARD
rows.response: i32 0, i32 count, i32[count] indices into cards; or i32 -1 to cancel when cancelable

rows.name: MSG_SELECT_CHAIN
rows.response: i32 chain index, or -1 to not chain (only when not forced)

rows.name: MSG_SELECT_PLACE
rows.response: count x (u8 player, u8 location 4=MZONE/8=SZONE, u8 sequence); a set bit in blocked = zone NOT available (bits 0-6 own mzone, 8-12 own szone, 14-15 own pzone, +16 for opponent)

rows.name: MSG_SELECT_POSITION
rows.response: i32 one POS_ bit that is in positions

rows.name: MSG_SELECT_TRIBUTE
rows.response: same as MSG_SELECT_CARD; sum of releaseParam of chosen >= min

rows.name: MSG_SORT_CHAIN
rows.response: i8 -1 to keep the default order, or i8 per card = its new position

rows.name: MSG_SELECT_COUNTER
rows.response: i16 per card: counters removed from it; total == count

rows.name: MSG_SELECT_SUM
rows.response: same as MSG_SELECT_CARD over cards (must are always included); param low/high 16 bits = values; mode 0 exact sum, 1 at least

rows.name: MSG_SELECT_DISFIELD
rows.response: same as MSG_SELECT_PLACE

rows.name: MSG_SORT_CARD
rows.response: same as MSG_SORT_CHAIN

rows.name: MSG_SELECT_UNSELECT_CARD
rows.layout: player:u8, finishable:u8, cancelable:u8, min:u32, max:u32, selectable:list<u32>[code:u32,where:loc], selected:list<u32>[code:u32,where:loc]
rows.response: i32 1, i32 index (selectable then selected); or i32 -1 to finish/cancel

rows.name: MSG_ROCK_PAPER_SCISSORS
rows.response: i32 1 scissors, 2 rock, 3 paper

rows.name: MSG_ANNOUNCE_RACE
rows.response: u64 with exactly count bits from available

rows.name: MSG_ANNOUNCE_ATTRIB
rows.response: u32 with exactly count bits from available

rows.name: MSG_ANNOUNCE_CARD
rows.response: i32 passcode that satisfies the opcode program (is_declarable)

rows.name: MSG_ANNOUNCE_NUMBER
rows.response: i32 option index
